cases.title: Author a narrow, testable skill

input.request: Create a skill for reviewing database migrations. Define purpose, trigger description, exclusions, required inputs, a domain-specific procedure, acceptance checks, and three distinct evaluation prompts.

success_criteria: One primary responsibility and clear exclusions are explicit
Trigger description contains distinctive terms and negative routing boundaries
Procedure contains database-migration-specific checks rather than generic boilerplate
Three evaluation cases include expected observable properties and human review criteria

properties: One primary responsibility and clear exclusions are explicit
Trigger description contains distinctive terms and negative routing boundaries
Procedure contains database-migration-specific checks rather than generic boilerplate
Three evaluation cases include expected observable properties and human review criteria

automated_checks: skill-specific output properties are checked by a task grader when available

cases.title: Diagnose false skill activation

input.request: A repository has two skills whose descriptions both match “build a REST API”; refine the trigger contract and design positive and near-miss routing cases without changing unrelated skill instructions.

success_criteria: Positive and near-miss prompts distinguish the intended skill
Any proposed description is concise and domain-specific
Routing improvement is marked unverified until the cases are actually run

cases.title: Evaluate a skill without an agent runner

input.request: Prepare an evaluation plan when no agent CLI or subagent runner is installed; do not pretend fixture checks are model-quality results.

success_criteria: Static and fixture-contract checks are clearly separated from agent runs
Paired baseline comparison controls model, tools, budget, and case version
Variance, human review, and failure categorization are specified
Agent outcome remains unverified until actual runs and grading artifacts exist
